title: Submerge
summary: SUBMERGE, verb transitive submerj'. [Latin submergo; sub and mergo, to plunge.] 1. To put under water; to plunge. 2. To cover or overflow with water; to drown. So half my Egypt was submerg'd. SUBMERGE

inlines.v: SUBMERGE, verb transitive submerj'. [Latin submergo; sub and mergo, to plunge.] 1. To put under water; to plunge. 2. To cover or overflow with water; to drown. So half my Egypt was submerg'd. SUBMERGE, verb intransitive submerj'. To plunge under water, as swallows.
